reviews.title: No Update for 2 Years
reviews.text: App doesn’t work. No Customer Support. Do not purchase!

reviews.title: Won’t let me make any stickers
reviews.text: I bet it’s a fun game for others but for me, I can’t even make any sticker packs or anything as soon as I tap on the button and type in the name I wanted it just kicks me out of the game. I’ve tried many many times about 10 so far and I just wanna tell you this so that you guys could probably fix it because now I’m just deleting the game.🤬😡😠
